Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 117: Holiday 2010
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #117 shipped to subscribers in November 2010 (bearing the cover date of Holiday 2010 or January 2011 for Issue 117). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #117 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom downloadable content, and exclusive media previews:

Dead Space 2 (survival horror third-person shooter)
Bulletstorm (first-person shooter)
Red Faction: Armageddon (third-person action-shooter)
Bionic Commando Rearmed 2 (Xbox Live Arcade side-scrolling platformer)
Torchlight (Xbox Live Arcade action RPG)
Hard Corps: Uprising (Xbox Live Arcade run-and-gun action)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews--featuring coverage for The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim, Batman: Arkham City, and Dragon Age II, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
